description: This script is designed to detect unresolved conflict markers in files within a git repository. It includes functions to identify conflict lines, list tracked files, check for conflict markers in files, and a main function that coordinates these tasks and reports any conflicts found.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a given buffer contains binary data by searching for null bytes.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Identifies lines in content that are conflict markers typically generated during merge conflicts.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files tracked by git in the specified directory.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Scans a list of files for conflict markers and returns violations, including file paths and line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that runs the conflict marker detection on tracked files and outputs results.
